finding: ASIC registers overview — what is searchable
value: asic.gov.au's 'Search ASIC's registers' page lists: business names register, company/organisation registers (incl. name availability), professional registers, banned & disqualified registers, court enforceable undertakings register, infringement notices register, public warning notices register, financial advisers register (via Moneysmart), unclaimed money search, and published notices (insolvency/external administration).

finding: Business names register — what the public record shows
value: ASIC's business-name-registration guidance states the public register displays the 'service of documents address' and 'principal place of business address' (for a home-based sole operator, only suburb/state/postcode is shown); email addresses and mobile numbers are not made public.
ASIC's business-name-availability checker uses a traffic-light system: green = name available, amber = requires manual assessment (e.g. 'made up' or unusual words), red = name unavailable.

The registration-cost figures for 1-year and 3-year business name registration were served as unresolved template placeholders ('{BZA}' / '{BZB}') on this fetch rather than dollar amounts — exact current fee NOT independently confirmed from this page.

finding: Access route for full register search
value: Page directs users to 'ASIC Connect' specifically for the business names register (plus a newer beta search tool), confirming ASIC Connect is the primary self-service portal for AU company/business-name lookups referenced by the provider plan.
